goal: Prevent debug log flooding for node operators running software that frequently requests block templates
agreement: Dedicated mining category preferred over existing noisy categories like mempool (Sjors, willcl-ark)
Withdrew objections over adding a new category and test for a single log line (l0rinc)
Release notes added as requested for block template and mining IPC users (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P4 because it has no impact on block template validity or mining performance
Benefit is limited to reducing log verbosity when block templates are requested frequently

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it gives operators a way to suppress unconfigurable debug log spam
Narrow in scope since it currently controls only a single log line
